IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[DIM_PACIENTE]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = '[dbo]')
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[DIM_PACIENTE]
	(
	 [ID_DIMPACIENTE] int,
	 [ID_PACIENTE] bigint,
	 [NOMBRE_COMPLETO] nvarchar(4000),
	 [FECHA_DE_NACIMIENTO] date,
	 [SEXO] nvarchar(4000),
	 [BARRIO] nvarchar(4000),
	 [IDSECTOR_OLTP] bigint
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

COPY INTO [dbo].[DIM_PACIENTE]
(ID_DIMPACIENTE 1, ID_PACIENTE 2, NOMBRE_COMPLETO 3, FECHA_DE_NACIMIENTO 4, SEXO 5, BARRIO 6, IDSECTOR_OLTP 7)
FROM 'https://azpaciencareetl.dfs.core.windows.net/datosprocesados/dw/DIM_PACIENTE.parquet'

	,MAXERRORS = 0
